open_questions.question: Does the official Empleos Públicos notice for Hospital Claudio Vicuña require EUNACOM, RNPI registration, a Chilean-recognized title, or a specific Internal Medicine certification?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It determines whether the 21 September vacancy is even theoretically reachable after credentials are validated.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Open the original notice from the live Empleos Públicos account/page and preserve its bases PDF before applying.

open_questions.question: Which post-17-August-2026 university will operationally process her Ukrainian medical degree and specialty recognition, and on what timetable?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This is the gate to clinical practice and to many clinically oriented academic posts.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Obtain written current-process answers from eligible accredited State universities and the relevant health regulators; do not rely on pre-change web pages.

open_questions.question: Can her Ukrainian rheumatology specialty be certified/registered in Chile after the primary degree route, and is EUNACOM required in her individual route?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The sampled clinical vacancies require registered specialty evidence and sometimes EUNACOM.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Request a case-specific written determination from Superintendencia de Salud/appropriate specialty-certification body after confirming the degree-recognition pathway.

open_questions.question: What Chilean residence status, if any, is available through her son and would it permit public employment?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Empleos Públicos expressly conditions foreign applicants on a residence permit.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Assess family-reunification facts and immigration eligibility with Servicio Nacional de Migraciones or qualified immigration counsel; do not assume the son automatically creates eligibility.

unknowns_declared: No currently open Chilean vacancy specifically titled Rheumatologist/Reumatólogo was located in the live, verifiable sources searched on 3 September 2026. This is not evidence that none exists; specialist vacancies may be unpublished, distributed through hospital networks, or absent from indexed pages.
The UChile Faculty of Medicine page is current in search results but does not display a source publication/update date, so it is recorded as UNDATED.
No live official SOCHIRE or Colegio Médico dedicated Bolsa de Trabajo URL could be verified; their home sites are provided only as professional-network monitoring channels.
The public Hospital Claudio Vicuña notice was located through a current secondary mirror, not a directly retrievable official Empleos Públicos page; its exact requisitos remain unverified.
I did not treat the 2025 MINSAL gap figures or the 2025 wait-list figures as job counts: both indicate demand, not an offer of employment.
A family-reunification route through her son is only a possible lever; his immigration status, relationship documentation and the applicable residence subcategory are unknown.
